questions.text: Match each passive sentence to its use.
questions.explanation: 1) A general fact → Fresh bread is sold here every morning.: Present Simple Passive виражає повторювану дію. 2) A completed past event → The bridge was repaired after the floods in 2019.: Past Simple Passive має конкретну дату завершеної дії. 3) Work happening at this moment → The main entrance is being painted today.: Present Continuous Passive: is being + третя форма. 4) A completed result relevant now → All the seats have been booked for the concert.: Present Perfect Passive указує на теперішній результат.

pairs: A general fact
Fresh bread is sold here every morning.
A completed past event
The bridge was repaired after the floods in 2019.
Work happening at this moment
The main entrance is being painted today.
A completed result relevant now
All the seats have been booked for the concert.

questions.text: Match the conditional type with its example.
questions.explanation: 1) Zero conditional → If you cool water below zero degrees Celsius, it freezes under normal atmospheric pressure.: Загальна закономірність: Present Simple в обох частинах. 2) First conditional → If the weather improves tomorrow, we'll go cycling.: Реальна майбутня умова: Present Simple + will. 3) Second conditional → If I owned a car, I would drive to work.: Нереальна теперішня ситуація: Past Simple + would. 4) Third conditional → If she had checked the address, she wouldn't have got lost.: Умова всупереч фактам минулого: had + V3 і would have + V3.

pairs: Zero conditional
If you cool water below zero degrees Celsius, it freezes under normal atmospheric pressure.
First conditional
If the weather improves tomorrow, we'll go cycling.
Second conditional
If I owned a car, I would drive to work.
Third conditional
If she had checked the address, she wouldn't have got lost.

questions.text: Match the active statement with its equivalent passive.
questions.explanation: 1) People grow coffee in this region. → Coffee is grown in this region.: Present Simple: множинний актив перетворюється на is + V3 для coffee. 2) Someone stole my bicycle last night. → My bicycle was stolen last night.: Past Simple Passive: was stolen. 3) They are interviewing the candidates now. → The candidates are being interviewed now.: Present Continuous Passive: are being interviewed. 4) They will publish the report tomorrow. → The report will be published tomorrow.: Future Passive: will be + V3.

pairs: People grow coffee in this region.
Coffee is grown in this region.
Someone stole my bicycle last night.
My bicycle was stolen last night.
They are interviewing the candidates now.
The candidates are being interviewed now.
They will publish the report tomorrow.
The report will be published tomorrow.

questions.text: Match each modal meaning with its passive example.
questions.explanation: 1) A strict requirement → Safety helmets must be worn on the construction site.: Must be + V3 виражає обов'язок. 2) A possible outcome → The missing documents might be found later.: Might be + V3 виражає ймовірність. 3) Advice about a procedure → The application should be submitted online.: Should be + V3 позначає пораду. 4) An ability or available option → The museum tickets can be purchased in advance.: Can be + V3 показує можливість.

pairs: A strict requirement
Safety helmets must be worn on the construction site.
A possible outcome
The missing documents might be found later.
Advice about a procedure
The application should be submitted online.
An ability or available option
The museum tickets can be purchased in advance.

questions.text: Match the conditional structure with its communicative function.
questions.explanation: 1) Unless we hurry, → we'll miss the last train.: Unless означає if not, отже реальна умова. 2) Provided that you follow the instructions, → you can use the software without difficulty.: Provided that вводить умову, за якої результат можливий. 3) Even if it rains heavily, → the charity event will take place indoors.: Even if підкреслює, що умова не змінить рішення. 4) If only I'd kept the receipt, → I could have returned the faulty item.: If only + Past Perfect висловлює жаль про минуле.

pairs: Unless we hurry,
we'll miss the last train.
Provided that you follow the instructions,
you can use the software without difficulty.
Even if it rains heavily,
the charity event will take place indoors.
If only I'd kept the receipt,
I could have returned the faulty item.

questions.text: Match the reporting or causative structure with its meaning.
questions.explanation: 1) It is believed that the painting is genuine. → People generally consider the painting authentic.: Impersonal passive передає поширене переконання. 2) He had his laptop repaired yesterday. → He arranged for a technician to fix his computer.: Have something done — замовити послугу. 3) She got her passport renewed last week. → She arranged to have her travel document updated.: Get something done — результат послуги. 4) The manager is said to have resigned. → According to reports, the manager left the job earlier.: Is said to have + V3 указує на попередню подію.

pairs: It is believed that the painting is genuine.
People generally consider the painting authentic.
He had his laptop repaired yesterday.
He arranged for a technician to fix his computer.
She got her passport renewed last week.
She arranged to have her travel document updated.
The manager is said to have resigned.
According to reports, the manager left the job earlier.

questions.text: Match the mixed conditional with the correct interpretation.
questions.explanation: 1) If Marta had taken the job, she would be living abroad now. → A past choice would have changed her present location.: Минуле рішення впливає на теперішній результат. 2) If I were less shy, I would have spoken at yesterday's meeting. → A current personality trait affected a past action.: Теперішня нереальна риса спричинила минулий результат. 3) Had they informed us, we would have prepared earlier. → They failed to notify us, so preparation was delayed.: Had they informed = If they had informed. 4) Were the museum open today, we could visit it. → The museum is closed, so visiting is not possible now.: Were + підмет інвертує Second Conditional.

pairs: If Marta had taken the job, she would be living abroad now.
A past choice would have changed her present location.
If I were less shy, I would have spoken at yesterday's meeting.
A current personality trait affected a past action.
Had they informed us, we would have prepared earlier.
They failed to notify us, so preparation was delayed.
Were the museum open today, we could visit it.
The museum is closed, so visiting is not possible now.

questions.text: Match each advanced passive construction with its equivalent.
questions.explanation: 1) The documents should have been signed yesterday. → Signing the papers was expected but did not happen by the deadline.: Should have been + V3 може вказувати на невиконаний обов'язок. 2) She is thought to be working in Brussels. → People believe she currently has a job in Brussels.: Is thought to be + V-ing стосується теперішнього процесу. 3) The suspect is reported to have left the country. → Reports suggest the person departed earlier.: Perfect infinitive позначає дію до повідомлення. 4) The road will have been completed by June. → Construction is expected to be finished before a future deadline.: Future Perfect Passive вказує на завершення до майбутньої межі.

pairs: The documents should have been signed yesterday.
Signing the papers was expected but did not happen by the deadline.
She is thought to be working in Brussels.
People believe she currently has a job in Brussels.
The suspect is reported to have left the country.
Reports suggest the person departed earlier.
The road will have been completed by June.
Construction is expected to be finished before a future deadline.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. Our school library (1)___ (open) every weekday at eight. The books (2)___ (arrange) by subject. New titles (3)___ (add) to the catalogue each month.
questions.explanation: (1) is opened — Present Simple Passive описує регулярне відкриття бібліотеки; у контексті дію виконує персонал. (2) are arranged — Books — множина, тому are + V3. (3) are added — Each month вказує на регулярне поповнення, отже Present Simple Passive.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. The old bridge (1)___ (build) in 1920. It (2)___ (damage) by a storm in 1998. The local council (3)___ (repair) it the following year.
questions.explanation: (1) was built — Пасивна дія з датою в минулому: was built. (2) was damaged — A storm спричинив дію, тому Past Simple Passive. (3) repaired — The council є виконавцем, отже активний Past Simple.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. If you (1)___ (heat) ice, it melts. If it (2)___ (rain) tomorrow, we'll take the bus. If I (3)___ (have) more free time, I would learn Italian.
questions.explanation: (1) heat — Zero Conditional має Present Simple в підрядній частині. (2) rains — У First Conditional після if вживаємо Present Simple. (3) had — Second Conditional: Past Simple щодо уявної ситуації тепер.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. Please use the side door because the main entrance (1)___ (paint) at the moment. The work (2)___ (finish) by the end of the week, according to the schedule. All visitors (3)___ (ask) to follow the signs until then.
questions.explanation: (1) is being painted — At the moment вимагає Present Continuous Passive. (2) will be finished — By the end of the week — майбутнє завершення; Future Simple Passive. (3) are asked — Visitors — множина, теперішнє прохання в Passive.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. The invitations (1)___ (already / send), so we cannot change the guest list. If someone (2)___ (cancel), we'll offer the place to another guest. The menu (3)___ (prepare) by the chef tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: (1) have already been sent — Already й результат зараз: Present Perfect Passive. (2) cancels — У First Conditional після if потрібен Present Simple. (3) will be prepared — By the chef й tomorrow указують на Future Simple Passive.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. If the warning (1)___ (issue) earlier, the hikers would have changed their route. The path (2)___ (close) before the rescue teams arrived, but nobody had noticed the sign. By the time the investigation ended, several mistakes (3)___ (identify). The final report (4)___ (publish) the following month.
questions.explanation: (1) had been issued — Third Conditional: попередня нереальна дія в Past Perfect Passive. (2) had been closed — Before іншої минулої події: Past Perfect Passive. (3) had been identified — By the time підкреслює завершення до минулої межі. (4) was published — The following month — конкретна подія в минулому, Past Simple Passive.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. If I (1)___ (know) about the scholarship last year, I would be studying abroad now. Had the university (2)___ (receive) my papers on time, I would have been considered. The application portal (3)___ (close) before I discovered the mistake. I wish I (4)___ (check) the dates more carefully.
questions.explanation: (1) had known — Минула нереальна умова з теперішнім наслідком — Mixed Conditional. (2) received — Інверсія Had the university received = If the university had received. (3) had closed — Попередня минула подія потребує Past Perfect. (4) had checked — Wish про жаль у минулому потребує Past Perfect.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. The new hospital (1)___ (expect) to open next autumn. Its design (2)___ (approve) by the council last year. The equipment must (3)___ (test) before any patients are admitted. By October, all staff (4)___ (train), according to the official plan.
questions.explanation: (1) is expected — It is expected / The hospital is expected to: reporting passive. (2) was approved — Last year позначає Past Simple Passive. (3) be tested — Після must утворюємо пасив be + V3. (4) will have been trained — By October визначає майбутню межу завершення: Future Perfect Passive.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. Unless the results (1)___ (verify) independently, the editor will not publish the article. If the figures (2)___ (be) inaccurate, readers could be misled. The data should (3)___ (check) twice before publication. Had the researcher followed this rule, the error (4)___ (avoid).
questions.explanation: (1) are verified — Unless = if not; у реальній умові потрібен Present Simple Passive. (2) were — Second Conditional: if the figures were, уявна умова. (3) be checked — Should be + V3 — модальна пасивна форма. (4) would have been avoided — Інверсія Had указує на Third Conditional; результат у пасиві.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct forms. The author is believed (1)___ (write) the novel during a long stay overseas in the 1990s. Her manuscript is said (2)___ (reject) by several publishers before one accepted it. She later had the first edition (3)___ (translate) into French. By the end of next year, the book (4)___ (publish) in twelve languages.
questions.explanation: (1) to have written — Is believed + perfect infinitive відносить написання до минулого. (2) to have been rejected — Пасивний perfect infinitive після is said стосується попередніх відмов. (3) translated — Have + object + V3 означає замовити переклад. (4) will have been published — Future Perfect Passive позначає результат до майбутньої дати.
